spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** Three fundamental truths, which have being in themselves, were ordained by the Divine itself. They were established in the external degrees of the mind — in the natural planes of consciousness.

**¶3:** The first fundamental truth is the [GAP-1] sustaining form of divine wisdom, the Divine Human fully realized, which was called forth [GAP-2] by the mediating principle of divine good made manifest. The Divine established it in this specific degree of spiritual life; [GAP-3] it extended its foundation from the lowest natural state to the highest celestial state. It bore up under the whole of the spiritual mind, and became the first among all sustaining truths in its spiritual capacities. In its certainty it has been confirmed and made immovable, and has secured every interior and exterior state alike.

**¶4:** [GAP-4] The second great and radiant fundamental truth is the new ground of wisdom, which was laid over the foundation of falsity from evil. It has broken apart the bonds of the five genera of evil that comprise spiritual death. It has established certainty, with supreme certainty, above and beyond the domain of falsity from evil. It has utterly subdued, destroyed, and sealed fast the very origin of spiritual death.

**¶5:** [GAP-5] The third fundamental truth is divine perception itself, which proceeded from the Lord as to his Divine Wisdom made glorious.

**¶6:** [GAP-6] These are the three fundamental truths: they that have come forth in perfect divine confidence, into three exalted and hallowed degrees of the mind. They were ordained and distributed across three principal degrees of these very planes of consciousness. They were confirmed according to the Providence of the Divine itself.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three great rocks, which exist, were appointed by the greatness. They were set in these outer worlds.

So, the first rock is the [Pillar] of Glory, the Perfect Man, which was summoned [by the] glorious Ambassador. He set it in this zone; [and he] brought forth its base (?) from the earth to heaven. It bore up under the [en]tire uni[verse], and became first of all the weight-carriers in [it]s powers. In its firmness it has been set upright, and has made fast every [t]hing above and below.

[The] second great and glorious rock is the new earth of light, which was set upon the earth of darkness. It has squashed the fastenings of the five storehouses of death. It has established firmness, with great firmness, over and beyond the earth of darkness. It has flattened, crushed and fixed the root of death.
[The] third rock is the great thought, which was summoned from Jesus, the glorious one.

[These] are the three great rocks, they that have come forth in great confidence, in three great and honoured places. They were appointed and distributed in three great places of these [self]same worlds. They were made fast according to the will of the greatness.

fills.explanation: The "Pillar of Glory" (Sṭūnā dᵊQūdšā) is the standard Manichaean cosmological term for the sustaining column of light, and the spiritual reading confirms a "sustaining form of divine wisdom" — a pillar is precisely a sustaining structure, making the editor's choice correct.

The passive construction "was summoned by the glorious Ambassador" is grammatically required, and the spiritual reading confirms the agent as the mediating principle ("by the mediating principle of divine good made manifest"), matching "by the" as the correct preposition and article.

The small gap bridges two clauses — "He set it in this zone" and "brought forth its base from the earth to heaven" — requiring a simple conjunctive subject "and he" to continue the narrative of the Ambassador's establishing action.

The paragraph introduces the second rock in parallel structure with the others; the spiritual reading confirms "The second great and radiant fundamental truth," requiring the definite article "The" to begin the sentence.
The paragraph introduces the third rock in the same parallel structure; the spiritual reading confirms "The third fundamental truth," requiring the definite article "The."

The concluding summary paragraph recapitulates all three rocks; the spiritual reading confirms "These are the three fundamental truths," and the demonstrative pronoun "These" is the standard Kephalaia formula for such recapitulations.
